'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Mike French DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike French]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
